items.title: Copper Edges Lower After World’s Biggest Mine Averts Strike
items.summary: Copper slipped after BHP Group’s Escondida mine in Chile, the world’s largest, averted a strike that would have tightened supply as the industry struggles to keep pace with demand from data centers and power grids.

items.title: Monsoon deficit raises risk of lower Rabi crop acreage
items.summary: Farmers are likely to decrease rabi sowing due to inadequate rainfall and reduced soil moisture levels. This situation could lead to lower yields of critical crops such as wheat, pulses, and oilseeds. Many reservoirs are under pressure, with over half storing less than last year. State and central governments are encouraging farmers to choose crops based on water availability, especially in water-scarce regions.

items.title: Early crushing to shore up sugar supplies before Diwali
items.summary: A quarter of Maharashtra's sugar mills will begin operations this week to alleviate sugar shortages before Diwali. Sugar prices have increased by approximately 4% recently due to dwindling supplies and farmer protests. Millers anticipate new sugar reaching markets after October 20, following crushing activities. items.summary: US inflation data for September shows an unexpected rise due to increased gasoline costs and broader price pressures. items.title: BlackRock, SBI MF lead Tonbo Imaging’s Rs 255 crore anchor round ahead of IPO
items.summary: Tonbo Imaging raised Rs 255 crore from anchor investors ahead of its Rs 852 crore IPO, allotting shares at the upper price-band limit of Rs 700. The entirely offer-for-sale issue will open on October 15 and close on October 19.

items.title: India's data centre policy in works, says Jitin Prasada
items.summary: India's government is preparing a data centre policy to enhance the hyperscale data centre sector. The proposed policy aims to streamline approvals and provide infrastructure status to the industry. A tax holiday until 2047 for eligible foreign cloud providers has also been announced. The use of artificial intelligence can improve power generation efficiency and flexibility for data centres.

items.title: Nifty's 200-day moving average sounds alarm as market breadth thins
items.summary: Only 10 Nifty 50 stocks traded above their 200-day moving averages on Wednesday, down from 38 in January, signalling weakening market breadth despite movements in the benchmark index.

items.title: Groww's net profit up 54%, equity derivatives' share in revenue dips
items.summary: Groww's Q2FY27 net profit rose 54% to ₹725.65 crore, while revenue grew 47% to ₹1,501.53 crore. Equity derivatives' share in revenue declined to 44.8% from 56.9% a year ago.

items.title: Kumar Mangalam Birla eyes $30 billion investment amid global uncertainties: ‘You either grow or you go down’
items.summary: Kumar Mangalam Birla plans to invest up to $30 billion across the Aditya Birla Group’s businesses over next two to three years, adding about increased spending in the United States. The Aditya Birla Group has operations in 41 countries, reported revenue of $72 billion in financial year ended March.

items.title: BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, Nomura among key investors as Zetwerk mops up Rs 2,251 crore in anchor bidding; IPO opens on Oct 15
items.summary: Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses raised Rs 2,251 crore from 99 anchor investors, including BlackRock, Goldman Sachs and Nomura, ahead of its IPO opening on October 15. The Rs 5,012 crore issue, priced at Rs 143–151 per share, comprises a fresh issue and an offer for sale. Subscription closes on October 19.

items.title: US Fed’s Bowman sees no urgency for another rate hike
items.summary: Michelle Bowman, the Vice Chair for Supervision of the US Federal Reserve, spoke during the IMF-World Bank meetings in Bangkok. She stated that the central bank does not feel urgency for further rate hikes at this time. Bowman's comments came after a recent rate increase that set the target range to 3.75%-4.00%. Additionally, she addressed the need for stronger oversight in light of recent bank failures.
